items.title: Thieves Snatch $4.6M Diamond Necklace From Viennese Museum
items.summary: The two thieves paid entry before stealing the 673- white diamond necklace that once belonged to Queen Nazli of Egypt.

items.title: The Belgian Exhibition That Strives to "Decenter" the West
items.summary: With two contradictory briefs — to both decenter Europe and show Bruges’s centrality in international networks — an exhibition on the Belgian city is already off to a bumpy start.

items.title: Demolition of Georgian Architectural Landmark Sparks Outcry
items.summary: Civilians, architects, and members of the preservationist community are advocating to save the complex known locally as the Rike Tubes in the capital city Tbilisi.

items.title: What I Got Wrong About Krasner and Pollock
items.summary: I had assumed that loving an artist meant disappearing a little, and I had assumed that Lee Krasner had been forced to shrink, too.
